description: "What symptoms / clinical features does [disease] cause" / "HPO phenotypes for [OMIM N]" / "clinical signs of [rare disease]" — list HPO phenotype terms for a disease ID (OMIM:N, ORPHA:N, or MONDO:N format). Use to enumerate clinical features of rare diseases. Example ID: OMIM:154700 (Marfan syndrome).
name: disease_phenotypes
